caption: The drawing depicts a single round shallow bowl with two elaborately decorated handles extending from the top and bottom, oriented vertically. The bowl itself is rendered with shading to represent its concave form, and it appears to be a metallic or reflective material due to the gradient shading. Both the top and bottom handles are similarly ornate, featuring symmetrical, filigree-like designs with circular and curved elements, and small open sections in the decoration. The drawing is executed in grayscale pencil, showing gradations from light to dark to create depth and detail. In the lower left corner, there is a small inset sketch showing the bowl in profile with dimensions marked, further indicating the diameter and width of the bowl and the height of the handles. The drawing is framed within a simple rectangular border, and there is a handwritten signature, "Charles Cullen," on the lower right. The paper has a slightly yellowed tone, suggesting age.
title: Pewter Porringer
